svg.title: Every Thread at Every Level
svg.desc: Sketch in perspective: a standing loom built from square posts and beams, seen from its front corner, with a mannequin beside it drawing one thread up and over the top beam. Three woven rows cross the upright threads; beside them, from top to bottom, are a diamond, a triangle, and a square. The thread being drawn passes through all three rows and is hatched; the middle row is not yet woven all the way across. The loom is the site. Its three rows are the levels of rules, in the site's column marks: the diamond is theory (metaconstitutional), the triangle is governance (collective-choice and constitutional), and the square is guides (operational). The upright threads are topic threads such as institutions or privacy. The hatched thread crossing every row is the solution, the focus: write about each thread at every level. The weaver is a contributor. The unfinished row is the cost the pattern names: a thread can look unfinished for a long time. The metaphor: the site as woven cloth, which holds together only where threads cross every level.
